m.h: Using Elder wood spirits for extra profit
m.post:
Elder trees take 5 minutes to cut down and 10 minutes to regrow, which means that the player has to select 3 elder tree locations and move between them. It is advised to bring equipment such as amulets to teleport to a bank, to store all logs held when moving to the next tree. Around 14 - 20 logs will be acquired on average per tree (per 5 minutes). Using an elder wood box will remove the need to bank.

There is a method that does not require any amulets to teleport:

  • Start in at the elder tree in Yanille
  • Cut the elder tree in Varrock
  • Teleport to Edgeville
  • Cut the elder tree in Edgeville and bank
  • Repeat

Another similar option is to use Varrock, and then the two trees to the north and south of Draynor Village, this allows banking at Draynor.

If the player doesn't own a Grace of the Elves, the aforementioned methods are recommended.

Various boosts can be used to increase log cutting speed:

  • A Beaver gives an invisible Woodcutting boost of +2. Beaver pouches are inexpensive, so it is worth it to use them. However, their multichop special move does not work on Elder trees.
  • A Ring of Whispers obtained after completing the Sliske's Endgame quest provides a 3% boost to woodcutting when equipped.
  • An augmented hatchet with the honed perk increases the success of gathering logs by 2% per rank.
  • Any God banner can give a +2 visible woodcutting boost for 30 minutes once a day.
  • Perfect juju woodcutting potion or perfect plus potion could increase log outcome by 5% every hour per dose (or 4 hours/dose with perfect plus).
  • A completed nature's sentinel outfit boosts woodcutting speed by 7% and also offers 20 daily teleports to tree locations.

There are also items that increase the potential profit:

  • A completed nature's sentinel outfit increases the rate of bird's nest drops by 7% and stacks with other boosts.
  • A strung rabbit foot also increases the rate of bird's nest drops and stacks with other boosts.
  • Any variant of the Woodcutting cape also increases the rate of bird's nest drops and stacks with other boosts.
  • Tree-shaking scrimshaws increase the rate of bird's nest drops by 300% (or 400% for the superior version) and also give a chance to spawn implings.
  • A dwarven chainaxe doubles the amount of logs received at the cost of XP. However, dwarven chainaxes are no longer obtainable and are set to be removed at the beginning of 2027.
  • A Grace of the elves charged with porters automatically banks the logs. However, this means that wearing the strung rabbit foot is impossible. Another option is to use sign of the porters. They can also teleport the bird's nests.
  • For those without convenient teleports, the Superior locator can be made at 81 Divination, which can teleport them to a random Elder Tree with each use. It's still a good option to have in addition to other teleport options.
  • A Waterfiend (familiar) has a 5% chance to duplicate any logs gained and stores them in its inventory.
  • Sana's fyrtorch increases the chance of successfully cutting logs by +6% when Woodcutting, and also provides a +20% chance of receiving an extra log. It also has a 12% chance of producing splintering arrow tips.
  • A Brooch of the gods can also help improve the bird's nests drop rate (by 20%), it is however not recommended, due to the scrimshaw having a better chance.

m.pg: Money making guide/Cutting eternal magic logs
m.h:
Eternal magic logs can be cut from the eternal magic trees which are located in Piscatoris Hunter area. When cutting trees occasionally a ray of light and falling leaves will appear on one side of the tree. Moving to this side will give a 30-second Lumberjack's Intuition buff, giving an increased chance to perform a Perfect Cut which guarantees that logs will be obtained. The buff also increases the chance to obtain bird's nests and a chance to obtain enchanted bird's nests, which may contain valuable rewards. The buff is enhanced with at least level 104 Woodcutting. The experience gained from woodcutting scales with the player's Woodcutting level. The trees last for five minutes before they are cut down, making this a low intensity money maker.

The perfect juju woodcutting potion grants a 5% boost to logs gained and 1 dose is used per hour.
m.post: The Perfect plus potion grants the same buffs as the perfect juju woodcutting potion but lasts for 4 hours instead.

m.h: Granite is the tertiary ingredient for granite lobster familiars, and while any size granite can be used for this, the 500 gram pieces are the cheapest and most in demand. You can make money by splitting the 2 kilogram pieces into four 500 gram pieces, for a profit of 10440 - 5533 gp each. Buy some Granite (2kg) on the Grand Exchange (they are sometimes difficult to purchase), and withdraw seven of them at a time. Craft the granite into 500 gram pieces, bank, and repeat. Each load takes about 12 seconds, so cutting around 2,000 pieces of granite per hour can be expected. Using a bank preset can speed up the process drastically and is recommended.

rq.h: 13 Crafting (50 Crafting (recommended))
Chisel

m.h:
An uncut jade can be cut with a chisel by a player with level 13 Crafting, and grants the player 20 Crafting experience. However, there is a chance that the player will accidentally crush it to form a crushed gem, which gives only 5 Crafting experience. This chance decreases with a higher Crafting level, and stops completely at level 50.

This guide assumes a player will cut 5,040 an hour, which may be higher or lower depending on player focus and intensity. The Grand Exchange buy limit is 5,000, so if a player plans on doing the activity for multiple hours continuously they will need to buy more in advance.

m.h:
Many trees may be found to the west of the Port Sarim docks, near the lodestone. Each tree gives a single log worth 802 coins and respawns quickly (in under a minute). Cutting the logs and banking them at the deposit box next to the monk of Entrana can be a fairly profitable way to make money with low skills.

Teleport to Port Sarim lodestone and start chopping all of the regular trees in the area. When your inventory is full, run north-east onto the docks and bank the logs. This should take about three minutes per load of 28 logs with a decent Woodcutting level, so you may be able to cut more than 500 logs per hour. When finished, sell the logs on the Grand Exchange. Any seer's headband will double logs received from cutting a tree, and double your profit.

Guam incense sticks, which give the player a 10-40% chance of cutting an extra log depending on the incense stick's potency, are recommended. Cadantine incense sticks, which have a base 2.5% chance of not exhausting a tree, could be a useful secondary incense effect.

The evil tree buff temporarily removes the need to bank logs and makes trees last longer, although it may be better spent on higher level trees such as mahogany or acadia, which would provide much better experience with a medium decrease in profit.

Depending on prices, it may also be worth it to fletch the logs into shafts, potentially yielding 264000 coins and making banking unnecessary. See Fletching headless arrows for more information.

m.h:
One mahogany tree is located on the southwestern part of Ape Atoll next to the beach. Collect mahogany logs here, and run east to the bank deposit chest to bank the logs. The tree spawns unusually quickly, so it is worth waiting for it to respawn and gathering a full inventory rather than running all the way to the deposit chest after the tree falls.

Jungle spiders, poisonous jungle snakes and poisonous scorpions found throughout the jungle. Wearing a monkey greegree will keep the monsters from attacking, but it also takes up an inventory space for your hatchet unless the hatchet is stored on the tool belt. These monsters can be completely avoided if you run along the southern edge of the island in a direct line from the mahogany tree to the deposit chest.

There is approximately a 2.5% chance that you will cut a Special mahogany log. You can use two of these to convert an inventory of mahogany logs into mahogany planks, saving 19,500 coins per special log. On average you will get about ten of these per hour, which means you can convert 130 logs for free by talking to the sawmill operator. It takes about 40 seconds to turn a batch of logs into planks, which can be done at any time after amassing enough special mahogany logs.

  • A Beaver gives an invisible Woodcutting boost of +2 which may give you more logs per minute. Beaver pouches are inexpensive, so it is worth it to use them. However their multichop special move does not work on Mahogany trees.
  • An augmented hatchet with the honed perk increases the success of gathering logs by 2% per rank.
  • A completed nature's sentinel outfit boosts woodcutting speed by 7% and also offers 20 daily teleports to tree locations.
  • Any God banner can boost +2 visible woodcutting boost for 30 minutes once a day.
  • Perfect juju woodcutting potion or perfect plus potion could increase log outcome by 5% every hour per dose (or 4 hours/dose with perfect plus).

Several oaks are located east of Draynor bank. Logs should optimally be cut from the closest two, and only go further if both are felled. The logs may then be deposited into the bank deposit box once a full inventory of logs has been collected. A full load of 28 takes approximately 90 seconds with a decent Woodcutting level, so about 1000 logs may easily be cut per hour. Oak wood box or higher can store more logs to reduce banking needed.

Another great spot to cut oak logs is directly south of the Draynor lodestone! In the southwest corner of the nearby crossroads, 4 oak trees are located in close proximity to one another. It is very easy to rotate from one tree to another while stumps regenerate without needing to move more than a couple of steps at a time. The player should bank at War's Retreat (combat level 60 required) optionally using the associated Teleport (not crucial as it is already quite close), deposit their logs, and exit via the portal to Draynor. After exiting, click on the intersecting paths of the crossroads, and Surge as you round the corner and face south in order to quickly return to the four trees and resume cutting.

The use of Oak wood spirits is not recommended, if their price is higher than that of one oak log.

Members using a Tree-shaking scrimshaw or its Superior variant should deactivate the scrimshaw prior to using the War's Retreat Teleport in order to conserve scrimshaw time while banking. When you've returned to the trees, your scrimshaw will be ready to activate once more.

Other good alternative locations include southwest of Varrock west bank, north of Lumbridge bank chest, or northwest of Falador north gate (with the Heist bank). There are 4 oaks just east of Jolly Boar Inn that is located just southwest of Fort Forinthry lodestone.

May's Quest Caravan is situated among oaks, but is members only.

m.h:
Five willows are located southwest of Draynor bank. A full load of 28 takes approximately 120 seconds at 90+ Woodcutting. Cutting willows is also one of the fastest ways to train Woodcutting in f2p (cutting maple logs or yew logs may be slightly faster, although the latter cannot be stored in any f2p wood boxes).

Willow logs are in high demand due to being raw materials for spirit weed incense sticks. While that is members-only, free players can make willow incense sticks. This requires 30 Firemaking and gives 36 Firemaking xp per stick (which consumes 2 logs each). Since sticks are stackable, this negates the need for banking, helpful if using any spot other than Draynor. It takes about 160 seconds per 13 sticks, or a profit of 410,844 gp per hour (includes both chopping and crafting).

m.h:
The profit rate assumes 12 kills per hour in duo without splitting drops. It also assumes that you hit the maximum contribution threshold to receive 12 lootpiles. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed, drops and failures. Duo is more profitable than 4-person because players are able to get 12 kills per hour with the maximum contribution, instead of 9. The reasoning behind this method is you are able to hit 420 contribution in less time, negating the need to wait for 2nd mid fungus.

Strategy

The Hunter & Woodcutter will always start the fight and starts at Hunt. Miner & Fisher starts at Mining. The Hunter should always have Extreme Hunter potion active whilst gathering.

Your optimal goal is to deplete both your nodes before going to the energy fungus; however, this won't always be possible due to luck. This is per player decision making. Go to the energy fungus when you feel like you should. It's not necessary to do the whole energy fungus - around 15% of it is sufficient.

  • Gather at Mining / Hunter until depleted and you have 15 materials, rot any excess and keep it with you
  • Go 1 quadrant anticlockwise and deposit the 15 materials into the statue
  • Start on that quadrant (Fishing / Woodcutting)
  • Gather until you have 20 rot and 15 materials with the node depleted. Use the dead guards if you must for the rot / materials
  • Poison the node
  • Go 1 quadrant clockwise back to your starting point and poison the node
  • Go 1 quadrant clockwise again and deposit the materials into the statue
  • Repair the statue
  • Pray on the statue but make sure you are both fully repaired and ready to before praying
  • Drink the relevant soup and attack the core. If it's Hunter drink an Extreme Hunter dose too, you can also 2-tick it
  • Be sure to click all the particles that are not red. If two ticking on hunter, it is sufficient to spam click the hunter cape(if its on the action bar it won't stop your current hunt.)

m.pg: Money making guide/Enchanting amulets of defence
m.h:
For this method the player needs to stand close to a bank. Make a bank preset of 27 emerald amulets and 27 cosmic runes, and wield the staff of air to remove the need of any air runes. Enchant the amulets by using the Lvl-2 Enchant spell, preferably placed on an action bar for better efficiency. This action (with banking) takes around 34 seconds making it possible to enchant up to 2,858 amulets an hour.

The buy limit per 4 hours is 5,000. You will have to wait 1 hour and 45 minutes before you can buy more off the Grand Exchange. It is possible to work around the limit by letting the order fill while doing other activities, directly trading with other players, or by using alternate accounts.

See also Money making guide/Crafting emerald jewellery.

Ascendri bolts (e) have a relatively high High Alchemy price and a high trade volume, so many players put them in the Alchemiser mk. II for passive profit.

The Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Ascendri) spell enchants 10 bolts at a time, using one cosmic rune, one death rune and 20 fire runes. Use a staff of fire for free fire runes. Click the Enchant Crossbow Bolt magic spell, which opens a menu to enchant bolts. 60 sets of 10 bolts can be made using the menu, taking approximately 142 seconds. This gives a theoretical upper limit of 15,000 enchanted Ascendri bolts per hour. As all inputs and outputs are stackable, there is no requirement to bank and this technique can be done anywhere.

If you prefer a more active method, it is possible using Tick manipulation to quadruple your profit and magic XP, by clicking on the Enchant Crossbow Bolt spell each Game tick, and confirming each click with your space bar. This method is high-intensity and is only maintanable over short periods of time, however it can be useful for clearing through your GE limit of bolts to fill Alchemiser mk. II.

The bolt market is fairly volatile, so test the profit of one set of bolts before you buy the runes and bolts in bulk. Maximise your profit by buying one Ascendri bolt (e) instantly, and sell all of yours for slightly less than what you paid. They may take a while to sell, but an extra 100 coins per bolt can double your profit.

m.h:
Castra debris are found south of the entrance in Kharid-et Dig Site. Just next to the prison door.

This method assumes a level 20 Archaeology and that you follow time sprites, intently. The profit rate assumes 400 gatherings per hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your drop rates, and intensity.

The main difference between Excavating Venator remains and this method is utilising the Kharid-et Dig Site's close proximity to materials cart for depositing the materials and filling the archaeological soil box with ancient gravel. Making the player spend less time travelling to the bank, which is located outside the dig site entrance, and more time gathering.

rq.n: Augmented Mattock of Time and Space
rq.t: Augmented Mattock of Time and Space

m.h: Excavate Tsutsaroth remains and destroy artefacts while selling all material gained. Only need to click about once every 7 minutes if you have the 10 minutes auto logout so that it starts a new artefact. Profit could be increased using anything that makes you use fewer signs of the porter, an XP capacitor, or a waterfiend familiar if desired. Did not calculate for charge usage, but it is fairly low for this method. You will want honed 6 on your mattock to get 1000+ materials per hour at 120 arch. If you click the next artefact quickly you can get more than 1000 materials per hour - this is a conservative estimate. 116 Archaeology required, but 120 will yield more material as will using Ring of Whispers to boost Arch level. On the recommended items list, each item missing will mean fewer materials per hour. Guide is calculated based on having all those items except for the waterfiend.

Venator remains are found just east of Al Kharid. This assumes level 20 Archaeology and following time sprites.

This is similar to excavating Third Age iron, which is usually more profitable, but venator remains cannot be depleted and there is no competition between players.

Screening ancient gravel can be very profitable, but is less so in free-to-play due to various limitations.

rq.h: 58 Archaeology (99 Archaeology (recommended))

rq.nt: to store porter charges if owned

m.h:
Travel to and excavate the material cache (Blood of Orcus) located on the of the Slayer Tower in Canifis. The Canifis lodestone is located nearby. There are 3 material caches that you can excavate from: you can also hop worlds if you deplete all the caches before they respawn.

This guide assumes the use of an elder rune mattock for collecting Blood of Orcus. Profits will be affected by the level of mattock used. To increase profit further players can use a mattock with perks such as Honed and Fortune. Using perks such as Imp Souled or Refined may reduce the usage of porter charges and the need to world hop. If owned the master archaeologist's outfit grants a 7% increased excavation rate; a ring of Whispers can invisibly boost Archaeology by 3 levels to increase excavation rate and the waterfiend familiar has the effect of doubling resources 5% of the time when gathering.

m.pg: Money making guide/Excavating material cache (Stormguard steel)

rq.h: 70 Archaeology (76 Archaeology (recommended))

m.h:
Excavation rates are based on near minimum level and non-augmented dragon mattock. Upgrades may significantly increase profit.

Stormguard steel can be excavated from material cache (Stormguard steel). There is a materials cart close by in the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site. Assuming you have unlocked 250 capacity for the archaeological soil box, it takes about 100 minutes for a full trip. World hopping is necessary as the caches deplete faster than they respawn (2 minutes).

Although not directly tradeable, you would also receive approximately 24 Torn blueprint fragments (Howl's workshop) per hour, which is worth an additional (3753232 + 4270736 + 3690802)/31.25 round 0 gp per hour on average when used to create a random blueprint.

m.pg: Money making guide/Excavating material cache (Third Age iron)
m.h: Third Age iron can be excavated from material cache (Third Age iron), with 3 caches north-east of the Archaeology Campus. With a bank a short distance to the west, each trip of 28 materials takes around 6 minutes on an empty world. Each cache usually gives multiples of the material before depleting, and it is shared among players.

m.pg: Money making guide/Excavating material cache (cadmium red)

rq.h: Archaeological soil box recommended

m.h:
Excavate the material cache (cadmium red) in the Star Lodge cellar at the Infernal Source Dig Site until it is depleted, hopping worlds each time it does so until the backpack is full. Bank it in the bank chest above the dig site and repeat.

It is highly recommended to use a soil box so as to increase the amount of cadmium red that can be excavated in a single inventory.

To increase the profit further, there are a number of additional items that are suggested:

  • An augmented mattock with perks such as Honed & Fortune. Using perks such as Imp Souled or Refined may reduce either the need to repeatedly bank or world hop
  • Ring of Whispers can invisibly boost gathering rates by 3%
  • Auto-screener v1.080 when used on material caches, only screens soil into the same gathering material for the cost of 3.33 charges
  • Master archaeologist's outfit has a 7% increase on excavation rate
  • Binding contract (waterfiend) when used has the effect of doubling resources 5% of the time when gathering. When used in conjunction with the other suggestions, can further increase profit.
